list.title: Off Work, Then I Become a Magical Girl
list.lastUpdateChapterTitle: Chapter 29: The End of the Song
list.synopsis:
Lin Yun, 36 years old, lost his wife early on. A mid-level manager in a private company and a single father, he’s been feeling the weight of a midlife crisis lately.  

His career has hit a rough patch, his relationship with his 14-year-old daughter is locked in a cold war, and he suffers from chronic shoulder pain that makes every day miserable.  

And just recently, he discovered a shocking secret—his daughter is a magical girl.  

A young girl, standing against extraordinary monsters, a hero protecting the city from attacks. That’s how the public sees magical girls.  

But he knows the truth—being a magical girl is dangerous.  

Should he stop her? Or should he respect her choice and find another way to protect her?  

Staring at the long-forgotten Heart Blossom gathering dust in his wardrobe, Lin Yun—the former magical girl who retired 19 years ago—faces the third major crossroads of his life.

list.title: Global Life Lottery: Only I Can Choose the Rewards
list.lastUpdateChapterTitle: Chapter 116: Jiang Yi? I Can Wipe Him Out with a Snap!
list.synopsis:
The apocalypse game has descended, and lifespan has become the only currency!  

Monsters drop various "Fate Roulette Wheels," which must be spun using lifespan as the cost!  

Some people spend ten years of their lifespan to draw an Elixir of Longevity, gaining an extra hundred years!  

Some spend a hundred years to gain powerful abilities and defy fate!  

Some spend a thousand years only to summon a terrifying beast horde, endangering an entire city!  

Jiang Yi painstakingly saved up a million years of lifespan to spin the golden roulette wheel—only to be obliterated by a flash of golden light, reborn at the very start of the apocalypse!  

Just as he thought his rebirth meant reliving the same gamble with fate, he made an unexpected discovery—  

As a reborn individual, **he could specify the rewards of the roulette wheel!**  

What the...?!  

Isn’t this basically—  

While others struggle and study diligently, he already has the test answers?!  

While others risk their lives gambling, he starts the game invincible?!

list.title: This Online Game Developer is Definitely Problematic
list.synopsis:
A turn-based online game that hadn't been updated for half a year, had a development budget seven times that of its competitors, yet only made a tenth of their revenue—a total failure. A game that everyone had already abandoned, right at the brink of being shut down… suddenly released a new version.

Lead designer Lin Yao.

From that moment, she became a legend.

—"The wildest ideas, the boldest moves, a complete game-changer. We never understand what she's doing, but she always ends up making more money than us..."

list.title: Only at the Mahayana Stage Does the Reversal System Appear
list.lastUpdateChapterTitle: Chapter 70: Jiang Li at Heaven’s Kill Pavilion
list.synopsis:
Jiang Li transmigrated into this world and found that he had no golden finger. Left with no choice, he could only cultivate diligently. Five hundred years later, he became the strongest person in the Nine Provinces.

Then, out of nowhere, a system appeared, claiming it could help him rise from the Qi Refining stage to become the number one in the Nine Provinces.

Jiang Li looked at the first mission and fell into deep thought.

"Please defeat your cousin (Qi Refining Stage 6)."

Jiang Li: "This system sure has some serious lag."

list.title: The Entire Villainous Clan Is Crazy, Except My Junior Sister Who’s a Goofball
list.lastUpdateChapterTitle: Chapter 89: They Are Not Good Enough
list.synopsis:
Transmigrating into a book, Ye Linglong became the malicious cannon-fodder female supporting character in a cultivation novel. Her aptitude was terrible, and she even forced the female protagonist to take her into the top sect during a cultivation tournament. After joining, she kept opposing the female protagonist, only to meet a tragic end.

To happily survive, Ye Linglong immediately gave up on threatening the female protagonist and turned her back on the prestigious sect. She joined the worst sect in the cultivation world instead. Being a malicious supporting character? Not for her! She just wanted to live beautifully on her own.

She thought joining the worst sect would let her laze around, eat, drink, and play like a salted fish. But who would’ve guessed that everyone in this “worst” sect was a borderline-insane villain, constantly on the edge of corruption, ready to sacrifice themselves one by one to the female protagonist?

Wait… Is their sect about to be wiped out? Don’t panic, she’s got this.

list.title: The Supporting Female Cultivator Makes Pills Just to Raise Kids
list.synopsis:
Song Li transmigrated into a cultivation novel as the villainous supporting character who bullied the female lead and was thrown into the Tower of Abandoned Infants by her own brother, dying at the hands of countless vengeful infant spirits.

Waking up in the Tower of Abandoned Infants and seeing countless crying spirits, Song Li declared, "I can be your mother."

The infant spirits, who were about to kill her, froze. Merging together, they transformed into an adorable and beautiful little girl.

Song Li decided to stay away from the original female lead, earn money by refining pills, and live a carefree life as a rogue cultivator raising her "child."

But unexpectedly...

"Are you really that famous merchant heir who spent fortunes on the female lead and handed over half a trading house to her?"
"I just healed one patient... turns out it was your brother. And now you don’t need to inherit the family business. Aren’t you happy about that?"
"Wait, are you the legendary Sword Spirit Body cultivator who paves the way for the female lead with your life? Why aren’t you interested in her? You even called her ugly? Could it be because I cured your chronic eye condition?"
"Hold on, are you the headstrong daughter of the Changming Sect Leader who was supposed to hand over the position to the female lead? What do you mean you’re not giving it away anymore? I didn’t mean to outshine you by making pills just to raise kids!"
The Three Swordsmen:

Song Li: "The Eagle with Foresight"
Lu Yan: "The Tiger Guarding the Mountain"
Xiao Yunhan: "The Wolf Skilled in Battle"
The Three Jokers:

Song Li: "The Donkey Producing Goods"
Lu Yan: "The Barrel for Carrying Rice"
Xiao Yunhan: "The Lad Selling His Services"

list.title: Pretending to Cultivate in Kindergarten
list.lastUpdateChapterTitle: Chapter 178: A Different Kind of "Nice Guy" Card
list.synopsis:
After failing to transmigrate to a proper cultivation world, Lin Zhengran woke up to find himself as a little kid... in kindergarten.
With no other choice, he decides to fool the system by pretending to cultivate.
[Today, you encountered a fairy descending the mountain. You must find a way to obtain the Pure Yang Elixir in her hand.]
Lin Zhengran looked at the milk candy in his childhood friend’s hand.
“Give me the candy. Do you need to go to the restroom? I’ll call the teacher for you.”
The little girl, confused and innocent, handed the candy to Lin Zhengran.
“Here’s the candy...”
[Congratulations! Without lifting a blade or striking a blow, you successfully obtained the Pure Yang Elixir from the fairy!]

list.title: Apocalypse Rebirth: The Boss Starts by Stockpiling Millions
list.synopsis:
Han Qingxia, a ruthless survivor who struggled in the apocalypse for ten years, was betrayed by her base and killed during a zombie siege.

When she opened her eyes again, she had returned to half a month before the apocalypse!

At this time, her scumbag father, selfish grandmother, and stepmother were still forcing her to vacate her house for her brother's wedding.

This time, Han Qingxia decisively sold the house to them at a rock-bottom price.

While they smugly thought they’d scored a huge bargain, Han Qingxia took the money and went on a crazy shopping spree to hoard supplies!

With the help of her super-strong cheat from the Super Base System, Han Qingxia built an unbeatable refuge:

When everyone else was trapped in the zombie crisis, Han Qingxia was relaxing on vacation in her shelter.
When everyone else was starving, Han Qingxia’s dog was feasting on buffets every day!
When everyone else was desperately fighting for space in survivor camps and living in fear, Han Qingxia’s base had already become the most indestructible steel fortress in the world!

list.title: Global Descent: Farming the Apocalypse with My Sister-in-Law
list.lastUpdateChapterTitle: Chapter 190: Departure to Hog Village, Druid's Advanced Form
list.synopsis:
"The update for Ice Age Era has been completed, officially launching the public beta. In one minute, all humans on Blue Planet will enter this game."
Starting with a small campfire, this is the initial area of activity. Players must continuously gather resources and upgrade the campfire level:
 Campfire → Large Campfire → Furnace → Energy Tower → Super Energy Station
By unlocking more buildings and recruiting various troops, they must develop their own forces in this harsh and extreme world.
Cao Xing, who has just transmigrated, unexpectedly activates the only hidden SSS-level talent: Eternal Power. At this moment, he realizes that by his side is a stunning sister-in-law...
Using his hidden talent, the two of them cooperate seamlessly, gradually expanding and strengthening their territory! As they explore the vast world, more secrets begin to emerge...

list.title: Wait, How Did My Digital Girlfriend Become a Sword Immortal?
list.synopsis:
My name is Chen Huai’an, and I have cancer. I’m dying. Lately, I’ve become obsessed with a virtual girlfriend game. I top up my account to buy her cultivation techniques and magical artifacts. Even though I’ve emptied my wallet, I laugh like a fool. I always thought it was just a game—until one day, my virtual girlfriend sent me a pill. The next moment, the pill appeared in my hand… Am I… not going to die?!

My name is Li Qingran. My cultivation has been crippled, my spiritual roots dug out, and I’ve been expelled from my sect. I cower in a dilapidated hut, waiting to die. I thought my life was over—until I met a mysterious senior who never shows himself. This senior heals my wounds and helps me cultivate. I grow stronger and stronger, eventually becoming the most powerful sword cultivator in the Cangyun Realm. I’ve heard that the spiritual energy in Cangyun is depleting, the Dao is dim, and an immortal from another world plans to merge their soon-to-revive realm with ours. An age of chaos and opportunity is upon us. Even immortals may face death in this struggle. I scour the world for traces of this senior. I want to protect him—and become his Dao companion!!!

list.title: Cultivation: I Studied Abroad in the Modern Times
list.synopsis:
Just as nuclear weapons are only a byproduct of scientific exploration, immortality is merely a small gift along the path of seeking the Dao. The New Dao Master, Grand Wise Teacher, and the strongest cultivator in millennia, Real Person Zheng Fa, is recruiting a personal disciple. The reference materials for applicants are as follows:

Topology in Talismans: Starting with the Little Rain Talisman
Research on Artificial Intelligence in Magical Tools: A Preliminary Exploration of Tool Spirits
Elemental Decomposition of the Nine-turn Golden Pill
Basic Pathways of Formation

Note: Priority will be given to those who have published papers in the Immortal Dao journal.

list.title: After Being Mind-Read, the Cannon Fodders’ Minds Exploded
list.synopsis:
A non-traditional cultivation novel featuring a bold female protagonist. Proceed with caution if this isn't your cup of tea!
[Mind Reading + System + Transmigration into a Book + Cultivation + Group Pampering]

Xiao Xiao unexpectedly dies and transmigrates into a cannon fodder substitute in a Mary Sue-style cultivation novel where the Female Protagonist’s admirers eventually gouge out her Golden Core to save the Female Protagonist.

Luckily, she has a system. Unluckily, it’s not a Comeback System but a useless Retrieval System.

What else could she do? She can only keep her head down, avoid forming her Golden Core, and dodge the tragic fate of being gutted.

[“Master is so amazing, yet he was tragically taken over by someone just to save his disciple. And that disciple, upon learning the truth, not only refused to seek revenge but even tangled up with the perpetrator. How ungrateful!”]
Master: ?!

[“First Senior Brother is a peerless talent and should have become a great Sword Immortal. But to save the one he loves, his Life-Bound Sword broke, and his dantian was destroyed. He ended up as a useless cripple.”]
First Senior Brother: ?!!

[“Second Senior Brother had it even worse. He wasn’t skilled in combat and only loved refining pills. Because of his low combat ability, he became a pawn in the Male and Female Protagonists' schemes. [“Sigh, and you thought she was your bestie? Turns out she’s been hooking up with your fiancé behind your back. They’re even planning to team up to get rid of you!”]
Cannon Fodder 1: F***!

[“And the other cannon fodders, who should have had brighter futures, ended up…”]
Various Cannon Fodders: !!!

list.title: A Daily Lottery Turned Me into a Witch
list.synopsis:
Transported to a Western fantasy world, I became a noble with garbage-tier aptitude. Although I awakened a talent that lets me draw a lottery every day, most of the stuff I pulled was pure junk. Hecate had already mentally prepared to lie flat and mooch off the family forever.

But unexpectedly, the lottery talent drew the Witch Seed.

Every gift from fate has its price clearly marked.

The moment he chose the Witch Seed, his affinity with magic hit the maximum. Just breathing in a bit of air would boost his power.

But the cost was...

list.title: The World Turns Into an Online Game, I Can See Patch Notes in Advance
list.lastUpdateChapterTitle: Chapter 43: A Bunch of Trash Trying to Play Robbers
list.synopsis:
Update:
The moment an update notice appeared before Su Chen’s eyes, the world’s fate was sealed—it would never be the same again.

Overnight, the entire world was gamified. Main cities rose up across the land, wilderness stretched endlessly, and danger lurked around every corner. Bloodthirsty werewolves danced madly beneath the full moon, while skeletal dragons soared across the sky, their massive bodies blotting out half the heavens.

But Su Chen had only one thought in mind: use his knowledge of future patch notes to seize the upper hand and stay ahead of everyone else.

First, he secured the one and only hidden talent reward and unlocked a path of infinite class changes. Then he kicked off a stockpiling plan!

Class 1: Trader
The materials that are dirt-cheap this patch? They’ll be hot commodities in the next one. Stock up!

Class 2: Puppeteer
Control countless puppets with invisible strings. One man becomes an army, invincible on the battlefield. And there’s even a hidden skill—Life-and-Death Substitute—making him practically unkillable!

Class 3...

As they say:
Every patch brings a new god, and every patch brings changes.

What’s just a weed this version, becomes a miracle herb in the next.

What’s dragon-strong today might be nerfed to a bug tomorrow.

With the ability to see update previews, Su Chen held the ultimate information edge. From that moment on, he began his cheat-code life and set his sights on the top of the world!

list.title: After Becoming a Witch, I Went Wild in the Magical World
list.synopsis:
This world is totally insane.

There are gods who’ve lost themselves, witches who’ve stolen divinity, churches that claim to worship gods but secretly covet divine power, and nobles who appear honorable yet eat people alive behind closed doors.

The entire continent’s history can be summed up in one sentence: survival of the fittest, profit above all.

A girl from Earth named He Mu was reincarnated into this twisted world, becoming the new Lord of Heim.

Thankfully, the Transmigration Authority didn’t forget to issue her a cheat—thanks to the Trait System, she began her ascent to godhood step by step.

But who would’ve guessed—

The world’s calamity, the master of death, the Little Western Lord of Heim, the forever-loli Reaper, the legendary Death Witch—Hel Heim...

The thing she regrets most in this life is putting on that d*mn “Witch” trait with her own hands.

list.title: Infinite Simulation: I’ll Be the Demon King at Level Fifty
list.synopsis:
Su Xiao: Is there something wrong with suddenly transmigrating into a magical world? Can’t I just be a normal person?

Good thing I’ve got the Simulation System!
Simulating again and again!

One day, I’ll take back everything I’ve lost!

Wait… I don’t think I actually lost anything…

Hold up… what do you mean there’s a necromancer outbreak about to wipe out the city?!
Huh? What do you mean hitting level fifty turns me into the Demon King?!

list.title: Hello, Yandere Psychopaths! I'm Here to Slack Off—We're a Perfect Match!
list.synopsis:
Tags: Quick Transmigration · “If You Don't Want Him, I'll Take Him” Romance · No Fixed Couple · Slacker Protagonist · Unhinged, Coercive Love Interests · Blackened Original Heroines

The heroines of certain dark romance stories despise the male leads' sick, obsessive, and deranged love. After being reborn, they resolve to stay as far away from these men as possible.
Jiang Tingyu, however, starved to death because she was too lazy to eat. After her death, she is bound to a system and tasked with receiving the male leads' love in their place.
P.S. In their previous lives, the male leads never loved the original heroines, nor did they have any intimate relations with them. The male leads are sexually inexperienced and have remained faithful!
World 1: The Tyrant with Headaches Who Obsesses Over His Minister's Wife
In her previous life, the heroine sold herself into the palace as a maid and was imprisoned by the tyrant in his bedchamber, forbidden to take even a single step outside.
She hated this treatment with every fiber of her being. When she unexpectedly learned that the little boy to whom she had pledged herself as a child had become the current imperial chancellor, her desire to escape grew even stronger.
The chancellor's wife enjoyed the benefits of her suffering in the previous life. This time, let her take the tyrant's abuse in her place!
World 2: The Insomniac CEO Who Clings to His Housemaid
In her previous life, the heroine applied for a job as a maid, only for the CEO to fall in love with her at first sight!
Unfortunately, she's extremely looks-conscious. With dark circles under his eyes and bloodshot eyes, the CEO looks like a ghost—definitely not her type.
Worse still, he's a controlling man who restricts her freedom, something she absolutely detests!
Given another chance at life, she will never steal her roommate's job interview opportunity. This time, she'll stay far away from him!
World 3: The Secretive, Obsessive Shadow Guard Who Spies on a Princess

list.title: The Gentle, Pretty Girl Is Cherished by the Gloomy Villain of the Apocalypse
list.synopsis:
【Alternate Apocalypse Setting / Many Original Elements / Romance-Focused / Both Leads Are Pure in Love / Sweet Spoiling】

Sang Yumo had been in love with Xi Youli for three years before finally gathering the courage to confess.

The good news: Her confession succeeded, and she got herself a boyfriend.

The bad news: She died in a car accident.

The even worse news: It happened right in front of Xi Youli.

Sang Yumo: “……”

Couldn't I at least have died looking prettier?

Only after her death did she discover that she was living inside an apocalypse romance novel—and that her boyfriend was the story's ultimate villain, the kind who kills people and disposes of their bodies.

Sang Yumo: “Impossible! My beloved boyfriend is obviously a sunny, upright, model young man.”

The system hurriedly arrived: “…What kind of nonsense are you talking about? Your boyfriend is the ultimate villain, the biggest obstacle in the male and female leads' romance. Do you have any idea how hard my job is?”

Sang Yumo didn't want to know how hard its job was.

“Then am I the villain's white moonlight? After I die, does the villain become corrupted and turn evil…?”

“You're overthinking it. You're just a completely insignificant side character.”

“??”



Sang Yumo came back to life—four years after her death.

By then, Xi Youli had become someone everyone feared, and her appearance seemed to burn away the last of his rationality.

He held her tightly, as if he wanted to merge her into his very flesh and bones. A cool, damp sensation brushed against the crook of her neck, and his voice choked with emotion.

“Liaoliao, is that really you? Have you come back?”



Xi Youli had always been deeply insecure.

He liked pulling her completely into his embrace, holding her with an unmistakably possessive grip, yet he would lower his head and kiss her lips with utmost caution.

Whenever she recoiled even slightly, he would react as though startled, immediately lowering himself to the lowest possible post

list.title: I Transmigrated into the Apocalypse and Became the Strongest by Pretending to Be Weak
list.synopsis:
Ji Zhou has been stuck in the apocalypse for eight years and is widely recognized as useless at the Linjiang Base.

She has undergone ability testing year after year, but the result has never changed:

No supernatural ability.
Physically weak.
Cowardly.
Whenever danger appears, she only knows how to hide behind everyone else.

Ji Zhou is perfectly satisfied with this.

Useless people have someone to protect them.

Geniuses, on the other hand, might get sent to the laboratory.

No one knows that something strange is hidden inside her body.

It can remember supernatural abilities.

Hardening. Lightning. Impact...

Give it enough time, and powers that originally belonged to other people can reappear in her body.

Relying on this hidden trump card, Ji Zhou has spent eight years pretending to be weak and quietly surviving.

She originally intended to keep it up.

Until the arena collapses.

As a massive beam crashes toward trapped survivors, she raises one hand in full view of the six major bases—and holds up the entire wreckage.

Her old testing records are urgently retrieved overnight.

The Central Base demands that she undergo another examination.

Researchers want to take her back.

Even her opponents in the competition deliberately injure her teammate, forcing her to take their place on the field.

Jiang Wang looks toward the Linjiang team's seats from behind the protective barrier.

“Don't they still have a substitute?”

“Put her in the team match.”

“I'd like to see how many blows that newly awakened Hardening of hers can withstand.”

Everyone assumes that Hardening is the only ability Ji Zhou possesses.

Only Xie Wenqi sits high above the arena, slowly rotating his right wrist wrapped in a support band.

He looks at the strange anomaly surrounding her—an area that refuses to change along with the Domain—and suddenly smiles.

“Just awakened?”

“She has been hiding much more than that for quite some time.”

list.title: Infinite Rewinds: They All Think I’m a Prophet
list.synopsis:
【Female Powerhouse + No CP + Supernatural Horror + Livestreaming + Rewinding + Fake Prophet】
【Heaven’s Mandate】

A terrifying game descends upon Earth, turning the entire world into a living hell.

Yi Yubai is unfortunate enough to be chosen for the game.

Even worse, due to a system allocation error, she dies immediately at the start.

But fortunately, she obtains an SSS-Rank Supernatural Ability:

【Infinite Rewind】

From that moment on, she becomes the mysterious and unfathomable 【Prophet】 in everyone’s eyes.

She predicts disasters.
She predicts life and death.

Medieval stone houses, blood-soaked opera stages, ancient villages deep in the mountains, abandoned hospitals, haunted hotels...

Every dungeon is a meticulously engineered deadly trap.

Thousands flee for their lives as countless ghosts wail.

Yet she alone remains standing where she is, staring directly into the abyss.

【God says—】

【Here and now—】

【There shall be—】

【DAWN!】

Special Skit

Dragon Kingdom viewers: “How did you know our Yi God cleared the dungeon again?”

Dragon Kingdom viewers: “How did you know Yi God is from our Dragon Kingdom?”

Dragon Kingdom viewers: “How did you know our country isn't polluted anymore?”

Dragon Kingdom viewers: “How did you know...”

Other countries: “……”

list.synopsis:
[Time Stop + Superpowers + Fanservice + Campus Beauties + Class Flower]

Zhang Feng awakens a superpower that allows him to stop time.

He starts with one minute.

Collect Time Fragments to increase the duration.

Congratulations! You found a Time Fragment on the campus beauty’s toy.

Duration increased by +1 minute.

You obtained 10 Time Fragments from the female celebrity’s pet.

Duration increased by 10 minutes.

Congratulations! You obtained a skill from a temporal rift.

Time Rewind.

A Millennium in an Instant.

Time Acceleration.

With Time Stop as his opening move, the entire world is his to command.

list.title: Awakening: EX-Rank Mage, Infinite Firepower from the Start
list.synopsis:
Tags: Global Class Awakening + Unique EX Class + No System + Leveling Progression + Multiple Top-Tier Talent Traits + Power Fantasy

The system descends, ushering the entire world into an era of global class awakening.

Those who awaken into combat classes slaughter their way through dungeons.

Those who awaken into life classes can only pray that their newfound skills will at least help them find a job someday.

Transmigrator Lin Bai is universally looked down upon during his awakening ceremony.

Then—

【Ding! Unique EX-rank class detected: Originator of Miracles!】

The light of awakening tears across the sky.

Day reverses into night. The mysterious descends upon the world, while the phantom image of an inverted city hangs over the earth.

【Class Trait: Gain one Miracle every time you advance by one rank.】

【Initial Miracle Unlocked: Never-Ending Reserves!】

【Mana: 980/∞】

(Your mana never runs dry. Any amount of mana consumed is instantly restored to full, but your mana cannot exceed your maximum storage capacity.)

While other mages are still reluctant to cast spells because of their limited mana during the early stages—

Lin Bai is already standing before a tide of monsters.

“Forbidden spell? Cast it whenever I want.”

When Lin Bai stands alone in the starry sky, a gigantic magic array spreading across the entire human world behind him, he faces countless alien races by himself.

The leader of the alien forces swallows hard and shouts:

“Don't be afraid! He's only a mage! Throw enough lives at him! Once we drain his mana, he's finished!”

Lin Bai clutches his chest in shock.

“Holy crap?! How can you people be so shameless?!”

list.title: Mr. Huo, Your Wife Has Wanted to Divorce You for a Long Time
list.synopsis:
[Angst Before Satisfaction + Crematorium Chase-the-Wife Trope]

Three years into their marriage, Huo Yanzhou's first love—the woman he'd never forgotten despite breaking up six years ago—returns from abroad.

She also brings back a five-year-old son.

Without hesitation, Yun Chu hands him a divorce agreement.

"Let's get divorced. It'll be better for you, for me, and for her."

The man merely replies indifferently,

"Can you really bear to divorce me?"

Yun Chu leaves the divorce papers behind and walks out of his life for good.

She cuts ties with the past and devotes herself to her career, rising to become a world-renowned sleep disorder specialist. Powerful figures across the globe owe her favors.

The youngest son of a European financial empire says,

"Yun Chu, hurry up and get divorced. I can't wait any longer."

The president of a multinational corporation says,

"Yun Chu, I'll accompany you to the courthouse on the day of your divorce."

A world-famous legal expert declares,

"I'll handle your divorce lawsuit."

...

Yun Chu has a headache.

It's not that she doesn't want a divorce—

It's that the man absolutely refuses to grant one.

With no other choice, she announces,

"Whoever helps me get divorced will sit at the head table at my divorce banquet."

Before long, Huo Yanzhou receives a lawyer's divorce notice during a shareholders' meeting.

Soon afterward, a multi-billion-yuan project is suspended.

That very afternoon, he is nearly struck by a car outside his own company.

...

Yun Chu arrives at the hospital carrying a flower basket.

"Let's get divorced. It'll be better for you, for me, and for everyone."

The usually cold and noble man locks her tightly in his arms, his eyes bloodshot.

"You want a divorce?

Only over my dead body."

list.title: It Was Only When We Were About to Divorce That I Discovered I Owned Two Billion Yuan Worth of Bitcoin
list.synopsis:
Tags: No System • Harem • Intelligent Wish-Fulfillment • Not a Beginner-Style Power Fantasy

With only two days left in the mandatory divorce cooling-off period, Chen Ang discovers an old USB flash drive while cleaning out his former home.

Inside are 4,735 Bitcoins.

Current value:

2 billion yuan.

Seven years ago, Chen Ang was the son of a wealthy family.

Then his father was framed in a financial scheme that drove the family into bankruptcy, and he fell from the heights of privilege into ruin overnight.

That same year, he painfully broke up with his first love.

Crushed by the double blow, he unknowingly fell into another trap.

A woman deliberately approached him, manipulated him into raising another man's son for six years, and was now preparing to divorce him and leave him with nothing.

After receiving the paternity test results, Chen Ang quietly puts the report away.

Then he says a single sentence to the woman demanding a divorce:

"We're not getting divorced."

Rather than tormenting himself...

He'd rather make life difficult for everyone else.

Every debt—

Every grudge—

Will be settled one by one.

Later, as Chen Ang considers having an heir to inherit his newfound fortune, several women begin to enter his life.

Then, unexpectedly...

His first love reappears.

And she's accompanied by a pair of twins.

list.title: My Classmates Chose Martial Arts or Immortal Cultivation—I Chose the Primordial World
list.synopsis:
A young man from Earth transmigrates to Blue Star, just in time for the day when everyone must choose between entering one of three worlds: the Martial Arts World, the Immortal Cultivation World, or the Primordial World.

While everyone else chooses the Martial Arts or Immortal Cultivation Worlds to maximize their chances of survival, he makes the unbelievable choice of entering the Primordial World—a realm with a 100% mortality rate.

The entire school erupts in shock. His mother faints. The news reports on it. Everyone thinks he's lost his mind.

What no one realizes is that, to the people of Blue Star, the Primordial World is completely unknown.

But inside the mind of this traveler from Earth lies the complete Nine Revolutions Mysterious Art and an encyclopedic knowledge of the Primordial World.

One year later...

He will either return in glory as an immortal patriarch...

Or leave nothing behind but his bones, forever buried within the Primordial World.

list.title: Startling Swan
list.synopsis:
Across the vast land of the Nine Provinces, there stands a renowned organization known as the Misty Rain Tower.

Its master, Li Qingzhi, is hailed as a peerless prodigy. From the shadows of the night, he holds the power of life and death in his hands.

Yet what the world does not know is that behind the Misty Rain Tower stands another figure—the true founder of the organization.

Disguised as nothing more than a carefree, good-for-nothing young master, he manipulates the tides of history from behind the scenes, pulling the strings of heroes and kingdoms alike as he lays his plans for the entire world.

list.title: You Want Me to Run a Breakfast Shop? I Don't Even Open Until the Afternoon!
list.synopsis:
[System + Gourmet Food + Slice of Life + Lighthearted Comedy]

Fan Li used to work in livestream operations.

Crushed by work pressure, plagued by insomnia, and constantly late for work, he is eventually fired by his company.

Just when his life hits rock bottom, he unexpectedly obtains the God-Tier Breakfast System.

The problem is...

His daily schedule has absolutely nothing in common with the lifestyle of someone who sells breakfast.

Customer #1:

"What?! In this middle-of-nowhere location, he's charging eighty-eight yuan for a basket of soup dumplings?!"

Customer #2:

"When exactly does this owner plan to open the shop? I can't take it anymore!"

Gradually, a bizarre scene begins appearing outside Fan Li's restaurant.

Under the blazing afternoon sun, crowds of customers line up...

To eat breakfast.

list.title: I Just Wanted to Study—How Did I End Up Becoming an Esports Legend?
list.synopsis:
[Top Student + Esports + System + Wish-Fulfillment + Lighthearted Comedy + No Female Lead]

Lu Ming is widely recognized as the hardest-working student at Changhua No. 6 High School.

He studies sixteen hours a day.

Yet despite all that effort, his class ranking remains stubbornly stuck around 70th or 80th place.

Then he binds to the Work-Life Balance System.

Expecting a study-assistance system, he instead receives an unbelievable instruction:

"Want to improve your learning efficiency? Go play Honor of Kings first."

Thus, the most hardworking student in school is forced to start gaming.

His classmates are shocked.

His teachers fall silent.

One hour later, he effortlessly finishes two sets of practice papers while his gaming skills improve dramatically.

To study better, he grinds ranked matches.

To climb the rankings, he studies harder.

And so, a whole new world opens before him.

After reaching the Top Three of the Honor of Kings Peak Tournament Rankings, he turns around and achieves a historically unprecedented perfect score in a national physics competition.

After winning the KPL Grand Finals Championship and claiming FMVP, he crushes every prodigy in the National High School Mathematics Competition.

Before the CS Stockholm Major Grand Final, he is still attending the award ceremony for a perfect-score gold medal at the International Mathematical Olympiad.

Eventually, the presidents of Tsinghua University and Peking University personally call to recruit him—

Only to discover that their rival is an esports club.

Meanwhile, the national esports team coaching staff slams the conference table in frustration:

"Who exactly is responsible for this guy? Why is the Chinese Academy of Sciences competing with us for him?"

During an interview, a reporter thrusts a microphone toward him:

"What's the secret behind your success?"

Lu Ming's expression is so sincere that it is heartbreaking.

"I swear... I only wanted to study."

list.title: Class Survival: Starting With a Pleasure Chair? Ten-Thousandfold Return
list.synopsis:
【Overpowered Start + Infinite-Flow Survival + Ruthless Protagonist + Large Harem + Pure Power Fantasy】

The apocalypse descends, and all humanity becomes bound to vehicles to begin a brutal survival game.

When talents awaken, they are determined by the object beside a person at the final moment.

Someone holding a red string awakens a spiritual ability.

Someone holding a scalpel awakens the power of dissection.

Someone eating beef awakens the power of flesh.

But Chen Yu, who has been reborn, heads straight to the Forbidden City and sits upon the gilded Dragon Throne in the Hall of Supreme Harmony.

From then on, his talent activates:

Ten-Thousandfold Return.

Rewards begin to appear:

Return: 10 tons of fresh crayfish

Return: 10,000 bottles of mineral water

Return: 10,000 daggers → Backpack capacity exceeded → Automatically exchanged for equivalent resources: Five-Thunder Heavy Sword

As time passes, more people keep joining his vehicle:

a teaching assistant senior,
a beautiful academic advisor,
an elegant older woman…

Chen Yu originally planned to simply carry everyone to victory—but why does the number of passengers keep increasing?

Wait a second…

There’s also an SSS-rank yandere on the vehicle—and she likes him?!

list.title: Something’s Wrong with This Game — I Became a God by Mining!
list.synopsis:
Professional gold farmer Yang Ling only wanted to relax in the game “Divine Realm.”

But after entering the game, he quickly realizes something is very wrong.

The environment is extremely harsh.
Danger lurks everywhere.

Worst of all—

Logging out isn’t possible.

Now trapped inside the game world, Yang Ling has no choice. For the sake of survival, he starts doing what he knows best:

Mining.

While others struggle to fight monsters and compete for resources, Yang Ling quietly digs deeper and deeper—

Leveling up, distributing stat points, and strengthening himself step by step.

What began as a desperate survival strategy slowly turns him into something far beyond an ordinary player.

A god forged through mining.

list.title: Just Became a Mage — Why Have My Skills Gained Consciousness?!
list.synopsis:
Tags: Power Fantasy + Noble Family Background + Personified Skills

Lin Mo transmigrates into a world where everyone undergoes Class Awakening.

He awakens as a Blank Mage with no elemental affinity.

Without any elemental talent, he cannot learn high-tier elemental spells.

Fortunately, his family is extremely wealthy. Lin Mo decides he might as well lie back and live the carefree life of a rich second-generation heir.

But then—

His skills gain consciousness.

[“Fireball” believes it has the potential of a Forbidden Spell and refuses to remain a mere lighter!]

[To prove itself, it runs away from home and begins slaughtering monsters on its own!]

[Congratulations! Your “Fireball” has independently evolved and learned ‘Multiple Explosive Fireballs’!]

[Congratulations! Your “Fireball” has independently evolved and learned ‘Explosive Spiral Dragon Flame’!]

…

[Congratulations! Your “Fireball” has comprehended the True Essence of Fire and evolved into — World-Ending Crimson Lotus!]

And that’s not all.

As Lin Mo levels up, every new skill he learns starts behaving strangely as well…

While other mages grind monsters day and night to level up, Lin Mo lounges under a sun umbrella sipping iced juice — while his skills are already going on killing sprees.

Years later—

The Abyss splits open. Trillions of Demon Gods descend, plunging the world into despair.

Lin Mo sighs helplessly:

“Stop fighting over it. Today… I’ll allow you unlimited firepower.”

In the next instant, the heavens lose their color.

Fire, earth, water, lightning, wood, light, darkness, time, space…

Forbidden spells from every element erupt like fireworks.

Trillions of Demon Gods are annihilated beneath the endless radiance of these spells.

A Demon God trembles and roars:

“W-What kind of monster are you?!”

Lin Mo exhales a puff of smoke and shrugs:

“I’ve said it countless times… I’m really just a mage.”

A stingy, money-loving Dragon-Powered Protagonist × A Delicate, Lustful, Truly Ordinary Human Girl

list.title: A Daoist Partner Sent by the Heavenly Dao: Immortal Venerable, I Suggest You Rein It In
list.synopsis:
Tags: Male–Male Romance · Xianxia · Cultivation · Childhood Companions to Lovers · Mutual Devotion · Sweet Romance · Power Couple · Lighthearted Comedy · Leveling Up
Shi Yao was born with a devastatingly beautiful face, but beneath that bewitching appearance lies a ruthless fighter capable of cleaving mountains with a single sword strike.
Originally a modern university student, he is reincarnated as the legitimate son of a cultivation aristocratic family. However, his concubine stepmother secretly switches him with another child, leaving him abandoned and cast aside.
Fortunately, Shi Yao possesses extraordinary talent. He originally plans to live as a carefree rogue cultivator, earn enough money to enjoy his retirement, and spend the next ten thousand years living as he pleases.
That is, until the Heavenly Dao assigns him a Daoist partner.
And that partner turns out to be a dragon.
Yan Jinghao is a Dragon Lord whose bloodline has reverted to its ancient origins and whose combat strength is off the charts. He rescues Shi Yao from the mire, raises him, spoils him, protects him… and then sets his sights on him.
Shi Yao (suddenly alert): “When exactly did our pure friendship become something else?”
Yan Jinghao (calmly): “It never was pure.”
After a pause, he adds, “No, wait. It never changed in the first place.”
— A gorgeous, formidable bottom × a dominant, fiercely protective dragon top. A relationship that grows from childhood, mutual devotion, sweet romance, and satisfying power progression.
Shi Yao appears “so delicate he can't even take care of himself,” but in reality, he can “send you straight to the afterlife with a single sword strike.”
1. Shi Yao suffers a rough start, but he is never weak. Yan Jinghao dotes on him without ever compromising his own dignity.
2. A lighthearted, comedic story featuring the collision of cultivation traditions and modern ways of thinking.
“I raised you myself, so naturally… you're mine, too.”

list.title: After Understanding Fluffy Animals, I Become the Regent King's Cherished Daughter
list.synopsis:
Tags: Super-Strong Adorable Child, Everyone's Favorite, Understanding Animal Speech

Her mother has just died when the little girl is picked up by a passing regent king and taken home.

Her mother was framed for losing her chastity before marriage. After giving birth to the little bastard that was her, she took her own life, leaving the girl an unwanted orphan.

The Regent King, who is rumored to prefer men, takes her in and hands her over to the Empress Dowager to prove his innocence!

The Regent King: “You are my daughter. As long as I am here, no one dares bully you!”

The Emperor Uncle: “Be good, little Nan. How about I grant you the title of princess?”

The Empress Dowager: “Oh, my goodness! I finally have a granddaughter of my own!”

The Princes: “This little dumpling is our little sister!”

—

One day, Chaochao suddenly discovers that she can understand mice. Their chatter helps her uncover the mastermind behind an assassination attempt on the Regent King.

The Regent King, furious: “Why did Prince Huainan try to assassinate me?”

Chaochao: “Because he suspects you picked up the concubine's bellyband that he stole!”

After chatting with a little bird, she discovers that someone plans to poison her Emperor Uncle at a palace banquet.

By talking to stray dogs, she uncovers the truth behind the disappearances of children throughout the city.

After chatting with the Empress Dowager's pet cat, she learns that the imperial consorts have been cheating on her Emperor Uncle.

—

Everyone comes to regard her as a bringer of good fortune, and she becomes the only princess of the Great Sheng Dynasty.

The very people who drove her mother out of the family home now come knocking at her door.

The Regent King fiercely protects his daughter: “You want to take my precious girl away from me? How many lives do you think you have?”

Later, they discover that the little girl looks more and more like her father. It turns out they really are biological father and daughter!

list.title: When a Beautiful Cannon-Fodder Character Enters a Horror Game
list.synopsis:
Tags: BG (Boy-Girl Romance), Everyone Is Drawn to the Protagonist, Multiple Male Leads, Male Leads Are Devoted and Sexually Inexperienced, Female-Lead Worship, Mild Horror, Infinite-Flow

Qiu Zhi is a frail, sickly girl—beautiful, timid, dull-witted, and painfully naive. Beneath her lovely, lotus-like face lies an utterly empty mind. At eighteen, she breathes her last on a hospital bed.

They say that hearing is the last sense to disappear after death. As the girl’s consciousness fades, she hears an electronic voice.

Welcome, Host, to the Nightmare Game. Please select your mission—

“The Wolf Is Coming”

You are an Asian girl who has transferred to a new school. A post predicting murders appears on the school forum, and the people described in the posts begin dying one after another. You seem to be an utterly ordinary girl with nothing to do with these incidents. But why, then, does your name appear in the posts, too...?

“The Haunted House”

You are a young wife who has married far from home. On your wedding night, you see a terrifying ghostly figure, but neither your husband nor your stepson believes you. You live in constant fear inside the haunted villa, until...

“Death Prophecy”

You are a survivor of a plane collision. Yet as time passes, the people who were lucky enough to survive the disaster begin dying one after another...

“Zombie Siege”

You are an ordinary person in the apocalypse. Your selfish boyfriend shoves you into a horde of zombies, then hurriedly flees, his retreating figure gradually disappearing from your sight...

“The Cabin in the Woods”

You are the girlfriend of a popular guy at school. You go on a vacation to a cabin in the forest with your boyfriend and his friends. On the very first night, a terrifying killer appears—but things seem to be more complicated than they appear...

“The Haunted School,” “The Möbius Loop,” “Escape from the Asylum”

More missions unlocking...

list.title: Investiture of the Gods: Betraying Xiqi at the Start, I Stand Firmly at Mianchi
list.synopsis:
Shen Wei transmigrates into the world of Investiture of the Gods. Through a twist of fate, he becomes Jiang Ziya’s disciple. Starting as an insignificant nobody in Xiqi, he fights his way up to become the Grand Marshal of the Vanguard.

He initially believes that by helping Xiqi conquer the Shang Dynasty and accumulating military merit and destiny’s favor, he can earn himself a chance to become a deity while retaining his physical body when the great calamity of the Investiture of the Gods arrives.

But when all five strategic passes have fallen and Chaoge is practically within reach, the reward awaiting him is not an honor or promotion.

His elite cavalry is taken away, his military authority is stripped from him, and Yi Jiang, the woman he has loved for ten years, becomes King Ji Fa’s queen. Even his own master, Jiang Ziya, personally cooperates with Ji Fa to strip him of his power, demanding that he accept his fate!

Ten years of warfare, and in the end, he turns out to be nothing more than a pawn to be discarded once his usefulness is exhausted!

Just as Shen Wei finally severs all ties with Xiqi, the system—ten years late—awakens!

[Choice One: Bow your head and accept your fate. Hand over the Tiger Tally, relinquish your armor, and accept a noble title. Withdraw from the great calamity of the Investiture of the Gods, retire to the mountains and forests, and enjoy a lifetime of worldly wealth and comfort.

Rewards: One Nine-Turn Golden Elixir! One high-grade acquired spiritual treasure—the Profound Origin Heart-Protecting Mirror!

Choice Two: Defy the Mandate of Heaven. Rebel against Xiqi and sever your master-disciple ties. From this day forward, go against the rising tide of the Zhou conquest and obstruct Heaven’s destined course for the Investiture of the Gods!

Rewards: Chaos Demon Physique! One innate supreme treasure—the God-Slaying Spear!

Choice Three: Garrison Mianchi.

Rewards: The Great Dao-level Scripture of the Chaos Great Dao and the Twelve Heaven

list.title: The Age of Universal Gods: My Traits Refresh Daily
list.synopsis:
Lu Sheng transmigrated into an extraordinary world where everyone could become a god, control laws, and create their own miniature worlds.

One day in the main world was equivalent to one year in a miniature world.

At the start, Lu Sheng awakened a C-rank talent trait, [Breeding Ground], and his miniature world also contained a B-rank building, [Spring of Spirit Eyes]. By all accounts, he was a genuine prodigy.

But no one knew that Lu Sheng possessed another talent: an X-rank ability called [Master of Traits].

Every day at midnight in the main world, a brand-new trait would appear in his miniature world!

And the traits he had already obtained would never disappear!

Then the trait [Fusion] appeared, and Lu Sheng began combining his existing traits one by one…
- C-rank [Breeding Ground] + B-rank [More Children, More Blessings] = S-rank resource trait [Nest of Abundance]
- D-rank [Beast Blood Boils] + A-rank [Innate Spiritual Physique] = SS-rank bloodline trait [Primordial Divine Beast Body]
- S-rank [Accelerated Evolution] + A-rank [Growth of All Things] = SSS-rank deduction trait [Mastery of Time]
Others could spend their entire lives acquiring only a single talent trait. But for Lu Sheng, top-tier traits were practically available for wholesale distribution!

…

[Record]: The spiritual energy concentration in your miniature world has increased ten thousandfold. Your subjects cultivate faster, and the probability of high-grade resources appearing has increased!

[Record]: A Saint-level being has emerged among your subjects!

[Record]: You have conquered a super-large Divine Kingdom. Please occupy this world as soon as possible and plunder its resources!

While his peers were still debating which resource cards to buy with their hard-earned Faith Points and how best to develop their subjects…

Lu Sheng’s miniature world was already filled with Saints. His people had established an Immortal Dynasty and were launching counterattacks against the gods of foreign race

list.title: High Martial Arts: You Look Down on Zanpakutō? What About Ryūjin Jakka, Then?
list.synopsis:
After transmigrating into a high-martial-arts world, Chu Yuan awakens a Martial Soul that turns out to be a Zanpakutō from the world of Bleach!

The problem?

Nobody in this world knows what a Zanpakutō really is, let alone its true name!

In their eyes, Zanpakutō are nothing but useless weapons that shatter at the slightest touch and have no potential for growth!

Fine! So that's how you want to play it?!

When Chu Yuan calls out the name of his Zanpakutō and awakens its true power...

When Chu Yuan releases his Zanpakutō's power in front of everyone's eyes...

And when Chu Yuan wields Zanka no Tachi, its Bankai form, and slays a ninth-tier Beast God with a single slash...

Only then does everyone in this world finally understand just how powerful Zanpakutō truly are!

list.synopsis:

list.title: Have You Gotten Your Ticket Yet?
list.synopsis:
Just before resources ran out, Ning Qing finally obtained the long-coveted ticket—the only chance she had to survive.

As a newcomer entering the game, Ning Qing begins her journey toward the pinnacle of success, one step at a time.

There is no miraculous tale of becoming a god overnight, but Ning Qing has plenty of time and patience. As for strength and ability, she will only keep accumulating more of both.

list.title: Building a Small Town in the Apocalypse
list.synopsis: Jian Ning accidentally finds herself in the apocalypse and becomes bound to a Town-Building System. In this desolate world, she builds a peaceful haven, a paradise untouched by the chaos outside. She also helps other safe zones work together to establish a new order in the post-apocalyptic world.

list.title: Cultivation Simulator: Killed by a Sword at the Start
list.synopsis:
Tags: Life Simulator, Everyone Loves the Protagonist, Cultivation, Love Triangle Chaos, Decisive and Ruthless, No CP, Comeback, Progressive Power-Up.

Only after Jiang Wan died did she discover that the world she had transmigrated into was not an ancient era at all, but the world of cultivation.

Unfortunately, she had no spiritual roots and was nothing more than an ordinary mortal, at the mercy of others.

Fortunately, when she opened her eyes again, she had returned to ten years earlier—and acquired a life simulator. Every time she died, it would generate a new trait for her.

【Fatal Beauty】 【Peerless Thief】 【Immune to All Poisons】 【Soul Out of Body】 【Irresistible Charmer】…

But she soon realized that something was terribly wrong.

A dignified emperor imprisoned her. A sinister Demon Venerable bound her to his side. A cold and aloof genius became obsessively devoted to her, while the young master of the demon race smiled as he poisoned her.

It seemed that every man she had flirted with had turned dark.

Death after death, restart after restart.

Only later did she learn that the most dangerous thing in this world had never been a man's love. It was the fact that the path to immortality offered no passage to mortals, and that fate regarded her as nothing more than dust.

A mortal woman without spiritual roots would never be admitted by the immortal sects.

If this cultivation world refused to let mortals ascend to the heavens, then she would defy it, climbing step by step by overcoming one seemingly fatal predicament after another.
list.lastUpdateChapterTitle: Chapter 35: Let Me Show You Something Fun

list.title: Starting with a Dormitory Bed: I'm the Strongest at Dorm Survival
list.synopsis:
Tags: Strong Female Lead, Feel-Good Power Fantasy, Revenge, Progressive Power-Up, Base Building, Cheat Ability, Playing Dumb to Outsmart Others

Story Progression: Early game — developing the dormitory; mid-game — survival while drifting on the water; late game — building a base on an isolated island.

What would you do if your roommate secretly used your washbasin to wash her underwear?

What would you do if the apocalypse arrived and your roommate generously gave your supplies away to students in another dormitory?

What would you do if your roommate threw a fit over a dirty bed, attracting zombies and putting the entire dormitory in danger?

Jiang Fengzhou, an NPC in an apocalyptic survival game, was bitten to death by zombies one moment, only to be reborn one hour before the apocalypse began the next.

The good news: She was reborn.

The bad news: Five of the game's infamous Top Ten Idiots—dubbed the “Crouching Dragons and Young Phoenixes”—were all living in the same dorm room as her.

In gaming circles, Dorm Room 566 was notorious for one thing: when its residents stuck together, they were a pile of crap; when they scattered, they became maggots swarming everywhere.

Just as Jiang Fengzhou listened to her roommate transform into a master thief for the 108th time, sneaking off with another squeeze of her shampoo, she decided to give up and wait for death—

Ding! Congratulations! You've drawn the Dormitory Safe House System!

Watching her shabby bed transform into the game's most formidable safehouse fortress, Jiang Fengzhou finally smiled.

While the five troublemakers were still blaming one another, fighting over supplies, and tearing each other apart, Jiang Fengzhou had already climbed into bed, munching on sunflower seeds as she watched the show.

A friendly reminder:

The first rule of surviving the apocalypse:

Stay away from idiots, and stay even farther away from lunatics.

list.title: Hello, Yandere Psychopaths! I'm Here to Slack Off—We're a Perfect Match!
list.synopsis:
Tags: Quick Transmigration · “If You Don't Want Him, I'll Take Him” Romance · No Fixed Couple · Slacker Protagonist · Unhinged, Coercive Love Interests · Blackened Original Heroines

The heroines of certain dark romance stories despise the male leads' sick, obsessive, and deranged love. After being reborn, they resolve to stay as far away from these men as possible.
Jiang Tingyu, however, starved to death because she was too lazy to eat. After her death, she is bound to a system and tasked with receiving the male leads' love in their place.
P.S. In their previous lives, the male leads never loved the original heroines, nor did they have any intimate relations with them. The male leads are sexually inexperienced and have remained faithful!
World 1: The Tyrant with Headaches Who Obsesses Over His Minister's Wife
In her previous life, the heroine sold herself into the palace as a maid and was imprisoned by the tyrant in his bedchamber, forbidden to take even a single step outside.
She hated this treatment with every fiber of her being. When she unexpectedly learned that the little boy to whom she had pledged herself as a child had become the current imperial chancellor, her desire to escape grew even stronger.
The chancellor's wife enjoyed the benefits of her suffering in the previous life. This time, let her take the tyrant's abuse in her place!
World 2: The Insomniac CEO Who Clings to His Housemaid
In her previous life, the heroine applied for a job as a maid, only for the CEO to fall in love with her at first sight!
Unfortunately, she's extremely looks-conscious. With dark circles under his eyes and bloodshot eyes, the CEO looks like a ghost—definitely not her type.
Worse still, he's a controlling man who restricts her freedom, something she absolutely detests!
Given another chance at life, she will never steal her roommate's job interview opportunity. This time, she'll stay far away from him!
World 3: The Secretive, Obsessive Shadow Guard Who Spies on a Princess

list.title: The General Store Connects the Past and Present, with Time Flowing Ten Times Faster
list.synopsis:
【Past and Present Connected · Debt Repayment · Getting Rich · Food · Heartwarming · Romance (Minor Focus)】
The fireworks factory owned by Jiang Ling’s family explodes, and her father dies in the fire, leaving Jiang Ling with a massive amount of debt.
With no choice, she has to drop out of school and return home to inherit her grandfather’s general store.
But what she never expected was that the general store has two doors. One leads to the modern world, while the other leads to the ancient world.
The key is that time flows at different speeds on the two sides.
When the sun is just rising beyond the metal shutter door, the sun is already setting beyond the wooden door...
Things that originally couldn’t be sold in the shop suddenly become priceless treasures in the ancient era!
Instant noodles, soda, fever medicine, cosmetics...
Jiang Ling has lost count of how many times she has said:
“I’m not a goddess!”

list.title: Reborn in the Apocalypse: Becoming a Nuclear Power Plant with Unlimited Energy
list.synopsis:
(The story leans toward a technology-themed, farming-and-development style. The protagonist disguises himself as an AI to interact with others. There is a system and some supernatural abilities, but this is not a hard science-fiction novel.)
After the zombie crisis breaks out, Ling Yu dies while trying to save others. To his surprise, after death, he is reborn as a nuclear power plant in his own city.
At the start, he faces more than 300 zombies throughout the facility and a reactor core on the verge of meltdown. All he has to work with are six cleaning robots and a surviving young woman armed with a crowbar.
Ling Yu has this to say:
“I’m just a harmless little nuclear power plant. What evil schemes could I possibly have?”
【Ding! Survivor sheltering target achieved. Reward: One thorium-based molten salt reactor!】
【Ding! Zombie-clearing target completed. Reward: One stellarator for controlled nuclear fusion!】
【Ding! Civilization development level requirement met. Reward: Antimatter engine technology!】
Starting with an ordinary pressurized-water reactor and progressing to a surreal engine capable of altering reality, Ling Yu expands from being confined to a single location to sailing across the sea of stars.
Step by step, he pushes civilization toward its ultimate potential.
This time, he will show the entire universe what a true mechanical catastrophe looks like.

list.title: After Leaving the Party, They Turn into Yanderes and Come Looking for Him
list.synopsis:
【Yandere · Daily Life · Love Triangle Drama · Romance · Multiple Heroines · Death Regression】

After transmigrating to another world, Su Qing obtains a system, but he must form an S-rank adventurer party to activate it.
However, that isn't important. The system thoughtfully provides him with a trial simulation of party formation.
Although the girls in the party all have their own issues, it is only a simulation, after all. Besides, he gains plenty of valuable experience from it.
After casually leaving the party and ending the simulation, Su Qing discovers that things aren't as simple as he thought.
“Why do all the locations in the simulation actually exist in the real world?”
At first, he doesn't panic. Instead, he enthusiastically embarks on his journey to assemble an adventurer party.
But why has the system suddenly activated on its own?
His plan to activate the system by forming an adventurer party has only just begun!
And another thing—what exactly does this system description mean?
【Hehe, you'd better stay alive~】
Before he can even process what's happening, he sees the young girl from his former party standing right in front of him—the one who once regarded him as her entire world.
Su Qing has a bad feeling about this...
Wait, what?! Why have my originally kind and amiable teammates turned into a bunch of yanderes?
Their emotions are extremely unstable, their fetishes are bizarre, their perceptions are distorted, and their possessiveness is off the charts...
What on earth is wrong with you girls?!
Our happy and harmonious... party wasn't supposed to be like this!
Give me back my peaceful, harmonious party!!!

data.synopsis:
Sacrificing his life to protect his best friend was a decision which Hui Yue did not regret, yet who could have known that death was not the final destination, but rather the beginning of a new adventure into a world filled with demonic beasts and martial arts cultivation.

Hui Yue soon found that within this world, strength was what determined your future accomplishments and there was no space for the weak. 

Embarking upon this new life, Hui Yue meets friends, experiences betrayal, and starts his own journey of cultivation to overcome his limits and become strong.

list.title: A Daoist Partner Sent by the Heavenly Dao: Immortal Venerable, I Suggest You Rein It In
list.synopsis:
Tags: Male–Male Romance · Xianxia · Cultivation · Childhood Companions to Lovers · Mutual Devotion · Sweet Romance · Power Couple · Lighthearted Comedy · Leveling Up
Shi Yao was born with a devastatingly beautiful face, but beneath that bewitching appearance lies a ruthless fighter capable of cleaving mountains with a single sword strike.
Originally a modern university student, he is reincarnated as the legitimate son of a cultivation aristocratic family. However, his concubine stepmother secretly switches him with another child, leaving him abandoned and cast aside.
Fortunately, Shi Yao possesses extraordinary talent. He originally plans to live as a carefree rogue cultivator, earn enough money to enjoy his retirement, and spend the next ten thousand years living as he pleases.
That is, until the Heavenly Dao assigns him a Daoist partner.
And that partner turns out to be a dragon.
Yan Jinghao is a Dragon Lord whose bloodline has reverted to its ancient origins and whose combat strength is off the charts. He rescues Shi Yao from the mire, raises him, spoils him, protects him… and then sets his sights on him.
Shi Yao (suddenly alert): “When exactly did our pure friendship become something else?”
Yan Jinghao (calmly): “It never was pure.”
After a pause, he adds, “No, wait. It never changed in the first place.”
— A gorgeous, formidable bottom × a dominant, fiercely protective dragon top. A relationship that grows from childhood, mutual devotion, sweet romance, and satisfying power progression.
Shi Yao appears “so delicate he can't even take care of himself,” but in reality, he can “send you straight to the afterlife with a single sword strike.”
1. Shi Yao suffers a rough start, but he is never weak. Yan Jinghao dotes on him without ever compromising his own dignity.
2. A lighthearted, comedic story featuring the collision of cultivation traditions and modern ways of thinking.
“I raised you myself, so naturally… you're mine, too.”

list.title: After Understanding Fluffy Animals, I Become the Regent King's Cherished Daughter
list.synopsis:
Tags: Super-Strong Adorable Child, Everyone's Favorite, Understanding Animal Speech

Her mother has just died when the little girl is picked up by a passing regent king and taken home.

Her mother was framed for losing her chastity before marriage. After giving birth to the little bastard that was her, she took her own life, leaving the girl an unwanted orphan.

The Regent King, who is rumored to prefer men, takes her in and hands her over to the Empress Dowager to prove his innocence!

The Regent King: “You are my daughter. As long as I am here, no one dares bully you!”

The Emperor Uncle: “Be good, little Nan. How about I grant you the title of princess?”

The Empress Dowager: “Oh, my goodness! I finally have a granddaughter of my own!”

The Princes: “This little dumpling is our little sister!”

—

One day, Chaochao suddenly discovers that she can understand mice. Their chatter helps her uncover the mastermind behind an assassination attempt on the Regent King.

The Regent King, furious: “Why did Prince Huainan try to assassinate me?”

Chaochao: “Because he suspects you picked up the concubine's bellyband that he stole!”

After chatting with a little bird, she discovers that someone plans to poison her Emperor Uncle at a palace banquet.

By talking to stray dogs, she uncovers the truth behind the disappearances of children throughout the city.

After chatting with the Empress Dowager's pet cat, she learns that the imperial consorts have been cheating on her Emperor Uncle.

—

Everyone comes to regard her as a bringer of good fortune, and she becomes the only princess of the Great Sheng Dynasty.

The very people who drove her mother out of the family home now come knocking at her door.

The Regent King fiercely protects his daughter: “You want to take my precious girl away from me? How many lives do you think you have?”

Later, they discover that the little girl looks more and more like her father. It turns out they really are biological father and daughter!

list.title: When a Beautiful Cannon-Fodder Character Enters a Horror Game
list.synopsis:
Tags: BG (Boy-Girl Romance), Everyone Is Drawn to the Protagonist, Multiple Male Leads, Male Leads Are Devoted and Sexually Inexperienced, Female-Lead Worship, Mild Horror, Infinite-Flow

Qiu Zhi is a frail, sickly girl—beautiful, timid, dull-witted, and painfully naive. Beneath her lovely, lotus-like face lies an utterly empty mind. At eighteen, she breathes her last on a hospital bed.

They say that hearing is the last sense to disappear after death. As the girl’s consciousness fades, she hears an electronic voice.

Welcome, Host, to the Nightmare Game. Please select your mission—

“The Wolf Is Coming”

You are an Asian girl who has transferred to a new school. A post predicting murders appears on the school forum, and the people described in the posts begin dying one after another. You seem to be an utterly ordinary girl with nothing to do with these incidents. But why, then, does your name appear in the posts, too...?

“The Haunted House”

You are a young wife who has married far from home. On your wedding night, you see a terrifying ghostly figure, but neither your husband nor your stepson believes you. You live in constant fear inside the haunted villa, until...

“Death Prophecy”

You are a survivor of a plane collision. Yet as time passes, the people who were lucky enough to survive the disaster begin dying one after another...

“Zombie Siege”

You are an ordinary person in the apocalypse. Your selfish boyfriend shoves you into a horde of zombies, then hurriedly flees, his retreating figure gradually disappearing from your sight...

“The Cabin in the Woods”

You are the girlfriend of a popular guy at school. You go on a vacation to a cabin in the forest with your boyfriend and his friends. On the very first night, a terrifying killer appears—but things seem to be more complicated than they appear...

“The Haunted School,” “The Möbius Loop,” “Escape from the Asylum”

More missions unlocking...

list.title: Investiture of the Gods: Betraying Xiqi at the Start, I Stand Firmly at Mianchi
list.synopsis:
Shen Wei transmigrates into the world of Investiture of the Gods. Through a twist of fate, he becomes Jiang Ziya’s disciple. Starting as an insignificant nobody in Xiqi, he fights his way up to become the Grand Marshal of the Vanguard.

He initially believes that by helping Xiqi conquer the Shang Dynasty and accumulating military merit and destiny’s favor, he can earn himself a chance to become a deity while retaining his physical body when the great calamity of the Investiture of the Gods arrives.

But when all five strategic passes have fallen and Chaoge is practically within reach, the reward awaiting him is not an honor or promotion.

His elite cavalry is taken away, his military authority is stripped from him, and Yi Jiang, the woman he has loved for ten years, becomes King Ji Fa’s queen. Even his own master, Jiang Ziya, personally cooperates with Ji Fa to strip him of his power, demanding that he accept his fate!

Ten years of warfare, and in the end, he turns out to be nothing more than a pawn to be discarded once his usefulness is exhausted!

Just as Shen Wei finally severs all ties with Xiqi, the system—ten years late—awakens!

[Choice One: Bow your head and accept your fate. Hand over the Tiger Tally, relinquish your armor, and accept a noble title. Withdraw from the great calamity of the Investiture of the Gods, retire to the mountains and forests, and enjoy a lifetime of worldly wealth and comfort.

Rewards: One Nine-Turn Golden Elixir! One high-grade acquired spiritual treasure—the Profound Origin Heart-Protecting Mirror!

Choice Two: Defy the Mandate of Heaven. Rebel against Xiqi and sever your master-disciple ties. From this day forward, go against the rising tide of the Zhou conquest and obstruct Heaven’s destined course for the Investiture of the Gods!

Rewards: Chaos Demon Physique! One innate supreme treasure—the God-Slaying Spear!

Choice Three: Garrison Mianchi.

Rewards: The Great Dao-level Scripture of the Chaos Great Dao and the Twelve Heaven

list.title: The Age of Universal Gods: My Traits Refresh Daily
list.synopsis:
Lu Sheng transmigrated into an extraordinary world where everyone could become a god, control laws, and create their own miniature worlds.

One day in the main world was equivalent to one year in a miniature world.

At the start, Lu Sheng awakened a C-rank talent trait, [Breeding Ground], and his miniature world also contained a B-rank building, [Spring of Spirit Eyes]. By all accounts, he was a genuine prodigy.

But no one knew that Lu Sheng possessed another talent: an X-rank ability called [Master of Traits].

Every day at midnight in the main world, a brand-new trait would appear in his miniature world!

And the traits he had already obtained would never disappear!

Then the trait [Fusion] appeared, and Lu Sheng began combining his existing traits one by one…
- C-rank [Breeding Ground] + B-rank [More Children, More Blessings] = S-rank resource trait [Nest of Abundance]
- D-rank [Beast Blood Boils] + A-rank [Innate Spiritual Physique] = SS-rank bloodline trait [Primordial Divine Beast Body]
- S-rank [Accelerated Evolution] + A-rank [Growth of All Things] = SSS-rank deduction trait [Mastery of Time]
Others could spend their entire lives acquiring only a single talent trait. But for Lu Sheng, top-tier traits were practically available for wholesale distribution!

…

[Record]: The spiritual energy concentration in your miniature world has increased ten thousandfold. Your subjects cultivate faster, and the probability of high-grade resources appearing has increased!

[Record]: A Saint-level being has emerged among your subjects!

[Record]: You have conquered a super-large Divine Kingdom. Please occupy this world as soon as possible and plunder its resources!

While his peers were still debating which resource cards to buy with their hard-earned Faith Points and how best to develop their subjects…

Lu Sheng’s miniature world was already filled with Saints. His people had established an Immortal Dynasty and were launching counterattacks against the gods of foreign race

list.title: High Martial Arts: You Look Down on Zanpakutō? What About Ryūjin Jakka, Then?
list.synopsis:
After transmigrating into a high-martial-arts world, Chu Yuan awakens a Martial Soul that turns out to be a Zanpakutō from the world of Bleach!

The problem?

Nobody in this world knows what a Zanpakutō really is, let alone its true name!

In their eyes, Zanpakutō are nothing but useless weapons that shatter at the slightest touch and have no potential for growth!

Fine! So that's how you want to play it?!

When Chu Yuan calls out the name of his Zanpakutō and awakens its true power...

When Chu Yuan releases his Zanpakutō's power in front of everyone's eyes...

And when Chu Yuan wields Zanka no Tachi, its Bankai form, and slays a ninth-tier Beast God with a single slash...

Only then does everyone in this world finally understand just how powerful Zanpakutō truly are!

list.synopsis:
Just before resources ran out, Ning Qing finally obtained the long-coveted ticket—the only chance she had to survive.

As a newcomer entering the game, Ning Qing begins her journey toward the pinnacle of success, one step at a time.

There is no miraculous tale of becoming a god overnight, but Ning Qing has plenty of time and patience. As for strength and ability, she will only keep accumulating more of both.

list.synopsis: Jian Ning accidentally finds herself in the apocalypse and becomes bound to a Town-Building System. In this desolate world, she builds a peaceful haven, a paradise untouched by the chaos outside. She also helps other safe zones work together to establish a new order in the post-apocalyptic world.

list.title: Cultivation Simulator: Killed by a Sword at the Start
list.synopsis:
Tags: Life Simulator, Everyone Loves the Protagonist, Cultivation, Love Triangle Chaos, Decisive and Ruthless, No CP, Comeback, Progressive Power-Up.

Only after Jiang Wan died did she discover that the world she had transmigrated into was not an ancient era at all, but the world of cultivation.

Unfortunately, she had no spiritual roots and was nothing more than an ordinary mortal, at the mercy of others.

Fortunately, when she opened her eyes again, she had returned to ten years earlier—and acquired a life simulator. Every time she died, it would generate a new trait for her.

【Fatal Beauty】 【Peerless Thief】 【Immune to All Poisons】 【Soul Out of Body】 【Irresistible Charmer】…

But she soon realized that something was terribly wrong.

A dignified emperor imprisoned her. A sinister Demon Venerable bound her to his side. A cold and aloof genius became obsessively devoted to her, while the young master of the demon race smiled as he poisoned her.

It seemed that every man she had flirted with had turned dark.

Death after death, restart after restart.

Only later did she learn that the most dangerous thing in this world had never been a man's love. It was the fact that the path to immortality offered no passage to mortals, and that fate regarded her as nothing more than dust.

A mortal woman without spiritual roots would never be admitted by the immortal sects.

If this cultivation world refused to let mortals ascend to the heavens, then she would defy it, climbing step by step by overcoming one seemingly fatal predicament after another.

list.title: Starting with a Dormitory Bed: I'm the Strongest at Dorm Survival
list.synopsis:
Tags: Strong Female Lead, Feel-Good Power Fantasy, Revenge, Progressive Power-Up, Base Building, Cheat Ability, Playing Dumb to Outsmart Others

Story Progression: Early game — developing the dormitory; mid-game — survival while drifting on the water; late game — building a base on an isolated island.

What would you do if your roommate secretly used your washbasin to wash her underwear?

What would you do if the apocalypse arrived and your roommate generously gave your supplies away to students in another dormitory?

What would you do if your roommate threw a fit over a dirty bed, attracting zombies and putting the entire dormitory in danger?

Jiang Fengzhou, an NPC in an apocalyptic survival game, was bitten to death by zombies one moment, only to be reborn one hour before the apocalypse began the next.

The good news: She was reborn.

The bad news: Five of the game's infamous Top Ten Idiots—dubbed the “Crouching Dragons and Young Phoenixes”—were all living in the same dorm room as her.

In gaming circles, Dorm Room 566 was notorious for one thing: when its residents stuck together, they were a pile of crap; when they scattered, they became maggots swarming everywhere.

Just as Jiang Fengzhou listened to her roommate transform into a master thief for the 108th time, sneaking off with another squeeze of her shampoo, she decided to give up and wait for death—

Ding! Congratulations! You've drawn the Dormitory Safe House System!

Watching her shabby bed transform into the game's most formidable safehouse fortress, Jiang Fengzhou finally smiled.

While the five troublemakers were still blaming one another, fighting over supplies, and tearing each other apart, Jiang Fengzhou had already climbed into bed, munching on sunflower seeds as she watched the show.

A friendly reminder:

The first rule of surviving the apocalypse:

Stay away from idiots, and stay even farther away from lunatics.

list.title: Hello, Yandere Psychopaths! I'm Here to Slack Off—We're a Perfect Match!
list.synopsis:
Tags: Quick Transmigration · “If You Don't Want Him, I'll Take Him” Romance · No Fixed Couple · Slacker Protagonist · Unhinged, Coercive Love Interests · Blackened Original Heroines

The heroines of certain dark romance stories despise the male leads' sick, obsessive, and deranged love. After being reborn, they resolve to stay as far away from these men as possible.
Jiang Tingyu, however, starved to death because she was too lazy to eat. After her death, she is bound to a system and tasked with receiving the male leads' love in their place.
P.S. In their previous lives, the male leads never loved the original heroines, nor did they have any intimate relations with them. The male leads are sexually inexperienced and have remained faithful!
World 1: The Tyrant with Headaches Who Obsesses Over His Minister's Wife
In her previous life, the heroine sold herself into the palace as a maid and was imprisoned by the tyrant in his bedchamber, forbidden to take even a single step outside.
She hated this treatment with every fiber of her being. When she unexpectedly learned that the little boy to whom she had pledged herself as a child had become the current imperial chancellor, her desire to escape grew even stronger.
The chancellor's wife enjoyed the benefits of her suffering in the previous life. This time, let her take the tyrant's abuse in her place!
World 2: The Insomniac CEO Who Clings to His Housemaid
In her previous life, the heroine applied for a job as a maid, only for the CEO to fall in love with her at first sight!
Unfortunately, she's extremely looks-conscious. With dark circles under his eyes and bloodshot eyes, the CEO looks like a ghost—definitely not her type.
Worse still, he's a controlling man who restricts her freedom, something she absolutely detests!
Given another chance at life, she will never steal her roommate's job interview opportunity. This time, she'll stay far away from him!
World 3: The Secretive, Obsessive Shadow Guard Who Spies on a Princess
